summary.text: Your payouts come through PayNow-NRIC, GIRO or GovCash. Linking your NRIC to PayNow can help you receive them earlier.

details.heading: Ways to receive payouts
details.body: You will receive your payouts through your PayNow-NRIC linked account, GIRO or GovCash.

details.heading: Receive payouts earlier
details.body: You are encouraged to link your NRIC to PayNow to receive your payouts earlier.
